description: This file defines a class `LatLng` and its related functions for representing geographical points with latitude, longitude, and optional altitude. It includes methods for equality comparison, string representation, distance calculation, wrapping longitude, and creating bounding regions, as well as factory functions for constructing `LatLng` instances from various inputs.

classes.name: LatLng
classes.description: Represents a geographical point with latitude, longitude, and optional altitude, providing methods for comparison, conversion to string, distance measurement, wrapping, and bounding.

methods.name: LatLng
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new LatLng instance with specified latitude, longitude, and optional altitude.

methods.name: equals(obj, maxMargin)
methods.description: Checks if another LatLng is at the same position within a margin.

methods.name: toString(precision)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the LatLng object.

methods.name: distanceTo(other)
methods.description: Calculates the distance in meters to another LatLng.

methods.name: wrap()
methods.description: Returns a new LatLng with longitude wrapped between -180 and +180 degrees.

methods.name: toBounds(sizeInMeters)
methods.description: Returns a LatLngBounds object around the point, given a size in meters.

methods.name: clone()
methods.description: Creates a copy of the LatLng instance.

methods.name: toLatLng(a, b, c)
methods.description: Factory function to create LatLng instances from various input formats.
